facts.fact: Defimedia reports the minister launched the Mobile ID, a digital wallet app of the national identity card, on 29 August 2024, downloadable by citizens holding a Maupass account.
Defimedia reports public organisations and businesses will have a separate app to verify identity via the Mobile ID, which also signs documents digitally.
Defimedia reports the Mobile ID, described by the minister as a digital wallet, was launched on 29 August 2024 and lets citizens carry their identity card data on a smartphone.

systems.owner: Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation

MUS.note: Nothing on the civil register or its link to the ID.
Only the minister's claim that the Mobile ID respects the Data Protection Act; no standing or application stated.
No enrolment count or share given.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Says Thales with Harel Mallac developed the Mobile ID; not who operates or maintains it.
No public register keyed on the ID number stated.

facts.fact: Defimedia reports all holders of a national identity card, including the latest MNIC 3.0, are eligible for the Mobile ID, launched 29 August 2024.

systems.owner: Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation

MUS.note: Minister's statement of an independent security audit is not a published audit.

facts.fact: Defimedia reports public organisations and businesses will have another app to verify a citizen's identity through the Mobile ID, with the citizen accepting or refusing each check.

MUS.note: Only a claim of compliance with international data protection norms; no standard named.
